item.title: Commerce Department Tightens AI Chip Export Rules to China
item.description: The U.S. Commerce Department announced new export controls restricting advanced AI chip exports to China, citing national security concerns over artificial intelligence chip technology.

item.title: Chipmakers Brace for New AI Export Restrictions
item.description: Semiconductor companies are adjusting supply chains after the Commerce Department's latest AI chip export restrictions targeting China took effect this week.

item.title: Startup Claims Breakthrough in Error-Corrected Quantum Computing
item.description: A quantum computing startup announced it achieved a new milestone in error-corrected qubits, a step toward practical quantum computing hardware.

item.title: Private Rocket Company Launches New Satellite Constellation
item.description: A private orbital launch company successfully deployed the first batch of its new satellite constellation, expanding broadband coverage.

item.title: Satellite Constellation Launch Raises Orbital Debris Concerns
item.description: Astronomers warn the latest satellite constellation launch from the private orbital launch company could worsen orbital debris and light pollution.

item.title: Patients Await Access After Gene-Editing Therapy Trial Success
item.description: Patient advocacy groups are pushing for expanded access following the gene-editing therapy trial's encouraging results this month.
